title: SWF: DefineSprite tag encoding for symbols
description: Unit tests for DefineSprite (tag 39) binary encoding in packages/swf. DefineSpriteTag wraps a symbol's timeline. Create a FlashDocument with a MovieClip symbol that has a few frames, export to SWF, parse the binary, locate DefineSprite tags, verify the sprite ID and frameCount are correctly written. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/definesprite.test.ts.
